userStories.title: Collapse steps while loading
userStories.description: Make chat Steps/tool-call disclosures collapsed by default even while a response is loading, while preserving visible progress in the collapsed header.
acceptanceCriteria: Steps/tool-call disclosures are collapsed by default during streaming/loading
The collapsed header still communicates progress with a spinner or concise status
Completed responses remain collapsed by default
The user can manually expand Steps to inspect activity/tool details
No redundant loading/status text is added elsewhere in the chat UI
Verification command passes
userStories.notes: Implemented collapsed-by-default Steps disclosures for iOS and Mac activity blocks while preserving the running spinner in the collapsed header. Verified with .ralph/verify.sh.

userStories.title: Place call button next to mic
userStories.description: Move the call button next to the microphone button and show it only when the composer text input is empty.
acceptanceCriteria: Call button appears next to the microphone button when the input text is empty
Call button hides when text exists so send/stop remains primary
Composer layout stays stable across empty, typing, dictating, uploading, waiting, and stopped states
Mac and iOS behavior remain consistent where the call surface exists
Verification command passes

userStories.title: Move project selector out of composer
userStories.description: Remove the project selector from the chat input. On new chat, show project selection centered below the Ask KishOS empty-state prompt. In an active chat, project context is read-only in header/sidebar.
acceptanceCriteria: Project selector is not shown inside the chat input/composer
New chat shows the project selector centered below the Ask KishOS prompt
Active chats show project/folder context as a small read-only affordance outside the composer
Follow-up messages continue using the conversation's locked project path
Verification command passes

userStories.title: Insert @ file and folder references
userStories.description: Add an active-chat bottom bar control that opens a file/folder browser and inserts @ reference tokens into the input as AI context, distinct from binary attachments.
acceptanceCriteria: A compact bottom-bar button opens a file/folder browser rooted at the selected project when available
Selecting a file inserts a removable @ reference token into the input
Selecting a folder inserts a removable @ folder reference token into the input
Sending includes structured reference metadata plus visible prompt text
References are treated separately from binary attachments
Verification command passes
